description: Official-source prototype essentials for remaining Golden 100 gaps: Sun Temple, Rajrappa, Sita/Hirni falls, library and fire emergency.

entities.name: Sun Temple, Ranchi
entities.description: Sun Temple near Bundu on the Ranchi-Tata Road is built in the form of a chariot with 18 wheels and seven horses.

entities.name: Chhinnamastika Temple Rajrappa
entities.description: Maa Chhinnamastika Temple at Rajrappa is a Shakti site at the confluence of the Bhairavi and Damodar rivers near Ramgarh.

entities.name: Sita Falls
entities.description: Sita Falls is a lesser-known waterfall near Jonha, about 40 km from Ranchi.

entities.name: Hirni Falls
entities.description: Hirni Falls is a forest waterfall around 70 km from Ranchi on the route toward Chakradharpur.

entities.name: Ranchi University Central Library
entities.description: Ranchi University's Central Library is a three-storey academic library serving students, teachers and researchers.

entities.name: Ranchi Fire Emergency
entities.description: Official government sources publish fire-emergency contacts for Ranchi and Jharkhand.

facts.value: The temple is designed as a chariot with 18 wheels and seven horses.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism describes the Sun Temple near Bundu on the Ranchi-Tata Road as a marble temple designed as a chariot with 18 wheels and seven horses.

facts.value: About 35 km from Ranchi on the Ranchi-Tata Road near Bundu.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism places the Sun Temple about 35 km from Ranchi on the Ranchi-Tata Road near Bundu.

facts.value: At Rajrappa, about 28 km from Ramgarh, at the confluence of the Bhairavi and Damodar rivers.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism places Chhinnamastika Temple at the confluence of the Bhairavi and Damodar rivers, 28 km from Ramgarh.

facts.value: About 40 km from Ranchi; Jonha railway station is about 1.5 km from the Jonha/Sita Falls area.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism describes Sita Falls as near Jonha and about 40 km from Ranchi.

facts.value: About 70 km from Ranchi on the way toward Chakradharpur.
facts.evidence: Jharkhand Tourism describes Hirni Falls as about 70 km from Ranchi on the way to Chakradharpur.

facts.value: The Central Library has more than one lakh books and serves Ranchi University students, teachers and researchers.
facts.evidence: Ranchi University describes its Central Library as a three-storey facility with more than 1.12 lakh volumes serving university users.
District Ranchi's disaster-management page publishes 0651-2283825 as the contact in case of fire.
The Government of Jharkhand state portal currently lists Fire 102 among statewide emergency numbers.
